summary: Iteration 9 — frontend review of (1) question sources/source_note editor rendering + review view, (2) generic previous-version label on /modules/{id} and /modules/{id}/learn, plus requested regressions. Pre-check: the app refused to compile — SyntaxError in src/pages/ModulePage.js line 23 (bare {expr} inside JSX ternary parens, missing fragment). I applied a minimal JSX-only fix (wrap `prog ? ( ... )` branch in `<>...</>`) so the rest of the test could run; no behavior change. After that: Admin /admin?onglet=relecture lists all 11 drafts as 'En relecture' (Q-M-001-G1..G5, A-M-001-G, M-001 v2, CO-001 v2, CO-002 v2, P-001 v2, P-002 v2). Opening Q-M-001-G3: 3 'Sources (ressource et passage cité)' rows with resource_id=A-002 and source_note empty — OK. Opening Q-M-001-G5: 4 Sources rows (2× A-001, 2× A-002) each with 'Passage cité' quote filled, and 'Note sur la source' = 'Scénario : exemple d'application inédit (assistant RH fictif), absent des ressources de M-001. Les citations justifient les notions évaluées (préparation, recherche documentaire, inférence), pas le scénario.' — OK. 'Historique des versions' panel renders (v1 'En relecture' entry with 'Renvoyée' event and 'Voir les 9 champs modifiés' link, no error). Published Q-M01-G1 (Contenus > Question): Sources list empty (only 'Ajouter une ligne' CTA, 0 resource selects), 'Note sur la source' textarea empty — OK. No approve/return/publish/save actions were performed. Previous-completion flow (QA learner qa-role-prev-80607@example.com, uid 6ad8cf92522dcb6f26fc0989, module_completions{module_id:'M01', module_version:0, completed_at:'2026-10-01'}): /modules/M01 → data-testid=module-previous-completion visible with text 'Terminé (version 0) · Nouvelle évaluation disponible' and module-previous-completion-link href=/modules/M01/learn?etape=evaluation (anchor); /modules/M01/learn → same label in header, link rendered as <button> that calls onGo('evaluation'), click navigates to ?etape=evaluation and renders the 'Évaluation notée — Valider le module' graded quiz step. Clean-up performed: module_completions(1) + user(1) deleted; 0 resource_progress / 0 attempts / 0 events for that uid; final qa-role-* users count = 0. Regressions: /modules/M01 as apprenant@casa-academy.ci → no module-previous-completion label (OK). /pathways/P-001 shows CO-001 (OK). BUT /modules/M-001 as apprenant@casa-academy.ci throws a runtime error 'Cannot read properties of null (reading \'passed\')' at bundle.js (ModulePage.js line 25: `prog.graded.passed`) — M-001 is L0 with no graded assessment so prog.graded is null and the CTA line crashes. This is a visible user-facing regression and blocks that page.

ui_bugs.issue: SyntaxError (unexpected token line 23) — bare {prog.previous_completion && <PreviousCompletion/>} inside JSX ternary parens without a fragment broke the whole app's compile. Testing-only workaround applied (<>...</>). Main agent should re-review the fix.

Runtime error 'Cannot read properties of null (reading passed)' on /modules/M-001 (L0, no graded assessment) because `prog.graded.passed` is accessed without null guard. Reproduce: login as apprenant@casa-academy.ci, open /modules/M-001 → full-screen 'Runtime error' overlay. Fix: guard with `prog.graded ? (prog.graded.passed ? 'réussie' : 'à passer') : 'non requise'` or omit the segment when !prog.graded.

action_items: Review the JSX fix in ModulePage.js (lines 22-28): I wrapped the `prog ? (...)` branch children in a React fragment so it compiles.
Add null-guard around `prog.graded` in ModulePage.ModuleCta progress summary — M-001 (and any no-graded module) currently crashes the module page for learners.
critical_code_review_comments: ModulePage.js:22-27 — the committed code had `{prog ? ( {expr && } ... ) : ...}`, which is a Babel parse error. JSX fragments or an explicit wrapper are required when returning multiple children from a ternary branch. Applied `<>...` as a strict syntactic fix to unblock testing.

ModulePage.js:25 — `prog.graded.passed` is read unconditionally; the backend returns `graded: null` for modules without a graded assessment (M-001). Must be null-safe to avoid breaking the public module page.

ModuleLearn.js:75 — `<PreviousCompletion onGo={() => go('evaluation')} />` correctly renders a <button> (not <Link>) when onGo is provided, and `go('evaluation')` navigates via the ?etape param — confirmed by click test.

fields.js:215-217 — sources (rows: resource_id + quote) and source_note (textarea) are correctly declared on the `question` content; both appear on PUBLISHED question editors (empty for Q-M01-G1) and on draft review views (populated for Q-M-001-G5). History panel renders without error.

success_rate.frontend: 6/7 scenarios OK — the only failure is /modules/M-001 runtime error for learners (regression).

rca of the issue: ModulePage.ModuleCta renders the progress summary `… évaluation {prog.graded.passed ? 'réussie' : 'à passer'}` for every learner. The /learners/me/modules/{id}/progress endpoint returns `graded: null` for modules that have no graded assessment (M-001 is L0, formative-only). Reading `.passed` on null raises TypeError and React's error boundary (Emergent overlay) replaces the page. Fix: null-check prog.graded before dereferencing, e.g. `{prog.graded && <>· évaluation {prog.graded.passed ? 'réussie' : 'à passer'}</>}`.
